note: Every comment the Qwen backend produced for two programs, recorded in test_results.md before any semantic rule existed, hand-labelled correct or wrong. 46 comments over two programs is enough to tune precision and to show the method works. It is not enough for a tight confidence interval on the error rate — grow it to a few hundred comments over more programs before quoting one as a headline number.
